units.rawText: When explosives were invented, a demand for demolitionists only naturally followed.
units.displayText: When explosives were invented, a demand for demolitionists only naturally followed.

spans.text: When explosives were invented, a demand for demolitionists only naturally followed.

units.rawText: Once they chose it as their profession, they were bound to be haunted by the Grim Reaper till the day they die. One tiny mistake and it'd be their last.

units.rawText: Eventually, with the creation of demolitionist Dolls, humans no longer had to put themselves in harm's way.
